full_judgment: 7. This right of pre-emption is completely, distinct from those available under the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 and the Non Agricultural Tenancy Act 1949. That is why, no right has been given to claim as co-pre-emptor under the Mohammedan Law as are available under Sub-Section (4)(a) of Section 24 of the Non Agricultural Tenancy Act or under Sub-Section (4) of Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. Under the said Acts the right to re-purchase has been given but under the Mohammedan Law, no such right has been given as mentioned above.
